versions.changelog: Fix: add clawdbot metadata block with requires.env and configPaths so ClawHub registry correctly reports SERPAPI_KEY credential requirement (was showing none)

Security: remove --key CLI arg from all scripts (prevents API key exposure in process listings); key now loaded from SERPAPI_KEY env var or credential files only. Fix: registry description now consistently declares the SerpAPI credential requirement.
Fix hidden unicode control characters (U+200D zero-width joiner, U+FE0F variation selectors) flagged by ClawHub security scanner
Remove hidden unicode/control characters (U+200D zero-width joiner, U+FE0F variation selectors) from SKILL.md flagged by ClawHub security scan
Remove blockquote formatting from credential section (was triggering false-positive prompt-injection flag in security scanner). Clarify SerpAPI requirement as plain prose.

Add explicit metadata declaring SerpAPI credential paths, file access, external requests, and optional calendar skill dependencies. Clarify credential setup and calendar access in skill body. Add README.md. Fixes false-positive suspicious flag from security scanner.
Step 6 calendar integration no longer assumes Google Calendar — detects whichever calendar skill is installed, falls back to .ics export for any calendar app.

Mode C now detects any installed calendar skill (google-calendar, outlook-calendar, etc.) instead of being hardcoded to Google Calendar. Falls back to asking user for dates if no calendar skill is found.
v1.0.1 — Calendar integration now works with any calendar skill (Google Calendar, Outlook, etc.) or falls back to .ics export. No longer assumes Google Calendar.

v1.0.0 — Real flight, hotel and transport search via SerpAPI (Google Flights, Google Hotels, Google Maps Directions). Supports single-destination and multi-stop itineraries, seasonal destination advice, calendar integration, and booking links for flights, trains, buses and ferries.
